name: profile_app_stack
description: Full Python/FastAPI application stack orchestrator managing Python runtime, venv, Git repo cloning, pip dependencies, .env file generation, PostgreSQL provisioning, Alembic migrations, systemd service deployment, logrotate, and Prometheus monitoring resources.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load balancer profile with static Hiera-driven backend configuration. Installs HAProxy, renders haproxy.cfg from a template, manages per-backend config fragments, UFW firewall rules, SSL/TLS termination, and the HAProxy service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis standalone/cluster node profile that delegates to the upstream puppet-redis Forge module. Configures bind address, port, password, maxmemory, eviction policy, and AOF persistence, with PuppetDB-based peer node discovery.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Test/development stub that replaces the puppetdb_query Puppet function with a no-op returning an empty array, allowing catalog compilation without a live PuppetDB connection during local Vagrant and container-based testing.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Functionally identical to the modules/profile_app_stack copy but with expanded OS support for RedHat 8/9 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04. Takes precedence over the modules/ copy via the modulepath ordering.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Extended version of the modules/profile_haproxy copy that adds a discover subclass using PuppetDB exported resources and puppetdb_query for dynamic HAProxy backend population. Also expands OS support to RedHat 8/9 and Debian 11/12.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Functionally identical to modules/profile_redis_cluster but with expanded OS support for RedHat 8/9 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04. Takes precedence over the modules/ copy via the modulepath ordering.

name: base_utils
description: Common base utility module included by all roles. Manages /etc/motd, installs OS-specific utility packages, and provides reusable defined types, custom types, and Puppet Bolt plans/tasks (rolling_restart plan, check_service task).
